findings.evidence: Local.lean:29-37 contains no inverse/division/`IsUnit`; :55-62 is `signVariationsAt_eq_of_alternate cs a r hne hfront ... hsame` verbatim, and that lemma is declared under Signs.lean:132 `variable {R : Type*} [Ring R] [LinearOrder R] [IsStrictOrderedRing R]`. The only field-requiring uses in the file are `q.signs_at_nonroot` (:89, :94, :111) and `Polynomial.signs_at_root` (:110), both below the `variable [IsRealClosed R]` line at :75. `grep -n 'IsAlternating' code/TauCeti` shows the only consumers are SignedRemainders.lean and Sum.lean, both of which already carry `[Field R]` of their own.
findings.fix: Change :24 to `variable {R : Type*} [Ring R] [LinearOrder R] [IsStrictOrderedRing R]` (keeping the existing `omit [IsStrictOrderedRing R]` on :41 and :64, and adding one on the `IsAlternating` declaration if it elaborates without the order), then insert `variable [Field R]` immediately before `variable [IsRealClosed R]` at :75, where `signVariationsAt_nonroot` and `root_jump` genuinely need it via `Polynomial.signs_at_nonroot`/`signs_at_root`.
findings.issue: `variable [Field R] [LinearOrder R] [IsStrictOrderedRing R]` pins the `IsAlternating` definition (:29) and `tail` (:42), `signVariationsAt_eq` (:55), `second_eval_ne_zero` (:66) to a field, though none of them uses an inverse, division, or `IsDomain`. The structure's three fields are `q ≠ 0`, `q.eval r ≠ 0`, and `q0.eval r * q2.eval r < 0`; `signVariationsAt_eq` just forwards to `signVariationsAt_eq_of_alternate`, which the author already moved to `[Ring R] [LinearOrder R] [IsStrictOrderedRing R]` (Signs.lean:132, :198). So a nearby more general theorem states the same content at a strictly weaker level, and the chain predicate that packages it cannot be stated there — e.g. for positively scaled pseudo-remainder chains over `ℤ[X]`, which the PR description names as the motivation for the relational formulation.

summary: Prior findings are fixed. One instance of the same field-pinning defect remains: the entire pre-`IsRealClosed` portion of `Sturm/Local.lean` — the `IsAlternating` structure and its three lemmas — sits under `[Field R]` while using no field operation, and `IsAlternating.signVariationsAt_eq` is a thin wrapper around a strictly more general theorem in `Signs.lean`.
